name: Song of Days Past
description: After your character receives healing from a source other than an Artifact: This card gains 1 stack of Yearning (max 4). At the start of the Round, for every 2 stacks of Yearning, heal the attached character for 1 HP. If this card has 4 stacks of Yearning, it heals for 1 additional HP, and DMG dealt by the equipping character is increased by 1.
